mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2% increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the past 6 months indicates rising inflation expectations, leading to higher interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPI growth does not correlate with interest rate changes (Pearson r < 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5% decline in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, leading to higher wages and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2% increase in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) over the past 6 months indicates rising economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances despite positive signal, or INDPRO growth does not correlate with economic activity (Pearson r < 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: A 1% increase in the Real Disposable Personal Income (RSAFS) over the past 3 months, combined with a 0.5% decline in the unemployment rate, signals rising consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 1% in 3 months and UNRATE falls > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in rising consumer spending periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5% increase in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months, combined with a 1% increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI), signals a tightening monetary cycle and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in 3 months and CPIAUCSL rises > 1% in 6 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or FEDFUNDS growth does not correlate with interest rate changes (Pearson r < 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: A 1% increase in the Nonfarm Payroll Employment (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months, combined with a 0.5% decline in the unemployment rate, signals a tightening labor market and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 1% in 3 months and UNRATE falls > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2% increase in the Housing Starts (HOUST) over the past 6 months, combined with a 1% increase in the Real Disposable Personal Income (RSAFS), signals rising consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 2% in 6 months and RSAFS rises > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances despite positive signal, or HOUST growth does not correlate with consumer spending (Pearson r < 0.3).
